issues.description: Function name mismatch for the tensor-network two-qubit gate helper: the problem statement (and the solution implementation) refer to a function named create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate, but the template defines a function named create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate. Specifically, problem_statement.md mentions create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate (problem_statement.md:80-83), the reference implementation declares create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate (solution_repository/tensor_networks.py:67), and the starter/template declares create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate (template_repository/tensor_networks.py:59). This naming inconsistency will confuse students about which function to implement and will break tests or example code that call the expected name.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the function name consistent across artifacts. Preferably rename the template function create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate to create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate (and update its docstring). If renaming is undesirable, add a thin wrapper in the template: def create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate(gate_matrix): return create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate(gate_matrix). Also update any tests/docs to use the unified name so students and tests target the same identifier.
